card.name: Heaven-directed verbs in scripture commentary
card.fires_on: Verbs and linking words in religious commentary where something comes from or is called down from heaven or God, such as sent, call, down, from.

modes.label: God sending or calling

modes.label: Fire or blessings from heaven
modes.description: The word down or from right before heaven in a Bible passage.
modes.example: making fire come down<< from>> heaven, with other signs or miracles.
